t: A palm-sized open-source walking robot with four legs and no wires.
steps: Open the Q8bot GitHub repo and read the parts sourcing guide.
Order the eight servos, bearings, two 14500 Li-ion cells, a Li-ion charger, and two XIAO ESP32-C3 boards.
Order an assembled main board from the shared PCBWay project, or solder one yourself.
Print the frame and leg parts from the latest v2.5 hardware files.
Install PlatformIO in Visual Studio Code and set each servo ID with the motor config firmware.
Assemble the robot and flash the main firmware to both XIAO boards.
Run the Python gait code on your laptop and try the first walk.
meta: Wild Open. From $599. A few stores.
